chunks.text: Today we will talk about Hungary.
Hungary is a historic, beautiful, and interesting country in Central Europe.
Let's learn about it in slow and easy English.
Where is Hungary?
Hungary is in Central Europe.
It is next to Austria, Slovakia, Ukraine, Romania, Serbia, Croatia, and Slovenia.
Hungary has no sea, but it has rivers and lakes.
What is the capital city of Hungary?
The capital city is Budapest.
Budapest is a large, historic, and beautiful city.
It has old buildings, bridges, castles, and the Danube River.
The city is divided into two parts, Buda, with hills and castles.
Pest with shops, cafes, and museums.
Other cities in Hungary include Debrecen, Seged, Pakes, Jure.
How many people live in Hungary?
About 10 million people live in Hungary.
Almost 2 million people live in Budapest.
Hungarian people are called Majars, and they are proud of their language, culture, and history.
What language do people speak in Hungary?
People speak Hungarian.
It is a unique language.
It is not like other European languages.
Some people also speak English, German, or French, especially in cities and schools.
What is the weather like in Hungary?
Hungary has four seasons.
Spring, warm and sunny.
Summer, hot, good for swimming.
Autumn, cool with yellow leaves.
Winter, cold, sometimes with snow.
The climate is mild and good for farming and outdoor activities.
What does Hungary look like?
Hungary has the Danube River flowing through Budapest.
Flat plains, hills, and forests.
Lake Balaton, the largest lake in Central Europe.
Villages, castles, and vineyards.
It is a great place for nature walks, boating, and sightseeing.
What animals live in Hungary?
In Hungary you can find deer, foxes, and hares, wild boars, owls, and storks.
Sheep, cows, and horses on farms.
Dogs, especially the Puli, a famous Hungarian sheepdog.
Many animals live in forests, fields, and national parks.
What do people eat in Hungary?
Hungarian food is rich, spicy, and hearty.
People eat meat, especially pork and chicken.
Paprika, a red spice used in many dishes.
Potatoes, onions, and vegetables, bread and noodles.
Popular dishes, guliás galás, meat soup with paprika.
Perkel, meat stew.
Langos, fried bread with cheese and sour cream.
Portabaggy pancakes filled with meat.
Dobos cake.
Chocolate sponge cake with caramel.
What do people drink in Hungary?
People drink water and fruit juice.
Tea and coffee.
Milk and soft drinks.
Adults may drink wine or palinka, a strong fruit brandy.
Hungary is known for its takaji wine, a sweet white wine.
What is life like in Hungary?
Life in Hungary is a mix of modern life and old traditions.
People enjoy spending time with family, going to thermal baths, hot water pools, listening to folk music, watching football, relaxing at cafes and parks.
In the countryside, people enjoy a simple and quiet life.
What are some holidays and traditions in Hungary?
National Day, March 15th.
Saint Stephen's Day, August 20th.
Christmas with lights and gifts.
Easter with food, games, and painted eggs.
Name days?
Each name has a celebration day.
Folk traditions include dancing, colorful clothes, and festivals with music and food.
Some fun facts about Hungary.
Hungary has over 1,000 thermal springs.
The Rubik's Cube was invented by a Hungarian.
The Hungarian language is one of the hardest in Europe.
Hungary has nine UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
The Hungarian flag is red, white, and green.
Now you know many things about Hungary.
You know where it is, what people eat, and how they live.
You learned about the land, food, and culture.
Well done.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
I am Emily.
